_handoff_notice: DROP-IN for qukaizen-dac. Place as model.json inside the physics WorldBundle (data/worlds/physics/ AND the exported dist/bundles/physics/). SEAL-EXEMPT — do NOT add to manifest.files{} / world_sha256. ARAIL reads it via current_model_hint() on mount and surfaces a one-tap 'this World recommends <model>' suggestion in the chat model picker (suggest, never auto-download). Optional; a World without it shows no recommendation.

recommended.rationale: Measurement & SI reasoning outruns the 1B default — the 2B Gemma generalist handles units, dimensional consistency, and constant values markedly better. Built with Gemma.
